kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem enable-data-ingestion --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --data-ingestion-id alibaba_cloud_sas_netstat_ingestion_1733260000000 --product-id alibaba_cloud_sas --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableDataIngestion

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
- **zh**（默认）：中文。
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to assume the permissions of the specified member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for
